response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and infrastructure experience with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) work, aligning well with the technical requirements. However, his direct experience in production-grade GenAI solutions and cloud-based AI systems is less explicitly detailed, warranting further exploration during an interview.
strengths: Extensive experience (10+ years) in full-stack development with TypeScript and Node.js, relevant to the role's language requirements.
Hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq, showing familiarity with modern GenAI tooling.
Proven leadership in technical projects, including open-source platforms and developer tooling, indicating potential for customer-facing technical leadership.
concerns: Lacks explicit mention of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, a core requirement for the role.
Experience with vector databases and RAG architectures is not clearly highlighted in the resume.
Cloud platform expertise (AWS/GCP/Azure) is implied but not detailed in the context of AI system design.
